goal: Make equipment-template import use the same in-app sheet experience as talent import, and make candidate packages use only a verified immutable media release for profession, specialization and equipment icons.
userValue: After choosing a community equipment template, the player sees a familiar two-tab import panel, then sees the imported equipment's own names and icons instead of generic slot glyphs or unnamed rows.
nonGoals: Do not make the Taro client infer names or image URLs from an untrusted raw icon key.
Do not change community template selection, gear legality, public release pointers or scheduled synchronization.
Do not use the unpublished static.chickenbro.cloud wow-media path in a candidate or production package.
Do not merge before one isolated candidate/API/package smoke and explicit real-WeChat acceptance.

currentTruth.knownRegression: The published runtime media root was not an actual static release, while the live community import payload exposed raw icon keys and left ring/trinket names unsealed.

mustChange: The equipment route presents the same application-owned saved/community template sheet as the talent route, without using the native import action sheet.
Candidate package verification reads the runtime-media release manifest and proves the configured immutable root is compiled into the package.
The deployment configuration preserves immutable /wow-media/releases static hosting across redeploys.
Current truth and the candidate runbook identify the verified api.chickenbro.cloud media release and explicitly reject the unpublished static origin.
mustNotChange: Community import remains fail-closed: the backend Gear Release and resolver own sealed name, displayName and iconUrl facts.
The client may render only trusted sealed media URLs and keeps the generic glyph as a visible fallback rather than fabricating item metadata.
Existing retail release pointers, source sync timers and production service remain unchanged during candidate verification.
The user's unrelated local worktree changes are not modified in place.
riskUnknown: The isolated candidate may expose an older community release whose import evidence is incomplete; that is a release/data failure, not a client-side fallback case.
A valid public release manifest and package compilation still require real-WeChat device verification of downloadFile/image behavior.
evidenceRequired: Red-to-green Taro tests for the template sheet and timestamp normalization, backend community-import/release tests, and the runtime-media/deploy regression test.
One exact-head isolated candidate with code hash, endpoint import audit, health, timer/backflow isolation and rollback path.
A release package gate against api.chickenbro.cloud that records a readable release manifest and a compiled runtime-media root.
Explicit real-WeChat acceptance of the sheet, imported names/icons and community import result.

ownership.factOwner: The backend Gear Release and canonical resolver own sealed equipment display facts; the immutable media release owns the image bytes; Taro only renders trusted payload fields and hosts the user-owned import interaction.

engineeringHealth.reason: The change crosses an active WeChat route, package compilation and persistent deployment configuration. It stays bounded by component-level regression tests, a manifest gate, an isolated read-only candidate and an explicit rollback to an empty runtime-media root.

acceptanceEvidence: Targeted frontend, backend and project-state tests pass at the exact task head.
The isolated candidate records its source identity, health/API import result, timer/backflow isolation and rollback command.
The release package gate reads the immutable runtime-media manifest and finds the configured media root in both isolated package builds.
The user explicitly accepts the three frozen real-WeChat items before merge.

decisionLog.decision: The user asked that equipment import return to the same visual experience as talent import after the merged UI regression.
The user identified missing equipment icons and names after community import and authorized investigation of the remote icon-loading pull request.
After the stale draft PR was found to fix only media hosting, the user authorized a current-main minimal port plus separate candidate verification of sealed community-import display facts.
